entrypoint: cd fairchem_repo && python src/fairchem/core/scripts/create_uma_finetune_dataset.py --train-dir <train> --val-dir <val> --output-dir <out> --uma-task <task> --regression-tasks <e|ef|efs> --base-model uma-s-1p2 ; fairchem -c <out>/uma_sm_finetune_template.yaml [hydra overrides]

stress.how_enabled: --regression-tasks efs selects uma_conserving_data_task_energy_force_stress.yaml, which gives the stress task a DDPMTLoss(MAELoss) coefficient 1 and removes inference_only; labels must include calc stress. data.regress_stress: True is set in all three templates, so stress is always computable at inference.

settings.name: --uma-task
settings.meaning: Selects the single UMA task/dataset name the fine-tune data is tagged with; becomes data.dataset_name and must match task_name at inference.
settings.default_note: no default: required=True, choices=[t.value for t in UMATask] (fairchem_repo/src/fairchem/core/scripts/create_uma_finetune_dataset.py:86-92)

settings.name: --regression-tasks
settings.meaning: Picks which data-task YAML is templated: e (energy loss only), ef (energy+forces), efs (energy+forces+stress).

settings.name: --base-model
settings.meaning: Written into base_model_name of the generated fine-tune YAML (HuggingFace facebook/UMA checkpoint name).

settings.name: --num-workers
settings.meaning: Multiprocessing workers for writing aselmdb shards (one data.NNNN.aselmdb per worker) and computing the normalizer/linear reference.

settings.name: base_model_name
settings.meaning: Foundation checkpoint name resolved via pretrained_checkpoint_path_from_name; replace model.checkpoint_location with a path for a custom checkpoint.

settings.name: epochs
settings.meaning: Number of epochs; exactly one of epochs/steps may be non-null (XOR asserted in the cosine scheduler builder).

settings.name: steps
settings.meaning: Number of optimizer steps, alternative to epochs (other must be null).

settings.name: runner.max_epochs
settings.meaning: TrainEvalRunner epoch limit (template interpolates ${epochs}); class default if unset.

settings.name: batch_size
settings.meaning: Per-rank batch size passed to BalancedBatchSampler for train and eval dataloaders.
settings.default_note: no default: keyword-only batch_size: int in the balanced batch sampler (fairchem_repo/src/fairchem/core/common/data_parallel.py:127)

settings.name: lr
settings.meaning: AdamW learning rate (runner.train_eval_unit.optimizer_fn.lr).
settings.default_note: no default in code: lr is set through the optimizer_fn partial passed to MLIPTrainEvalUnit (fairchem_repo/src/fairchem/core/units/mlip_unit/mlip_unit.py:500)

settings.name: weight_decay
settings.meaning: AdamW weight decay; _get_optimizer_wd reads it from the optimizer partial and exempts no_weight_decay params.

settings.name: optimizer_fn._target_
settings.meaning: Optimizer class instantiated by Hydra.
settings.default_note: no default: optimizer_fn: callable is a required constructor argument (fairchem_repo/src/fairchem/core/units/mlip_unit/mlip_unit.py:500)

settings.name: cosine_lr_scheduler_fn.warmup_factor
settings.meaning: Starting LR multiplier of the linear warmup in the fixed cosine LambdaLR schedule.
settings.default_note: no default: warmup_factor: float required in _get_consine_lr_scheduler (fairchem_repo/src/fairchem/core/units/mlip_unit/mlip_unit.py:407)

settings.name: cosine_lr_scheduler_fn.warmup_epochs
settings.meaning: Warmup length as a fraction of an epoch (multiplied by iterations per epoch, min 1 step).
settings.default_note: no default: warmup_epochs: float required in _get_consine_lr_scheduler (fairchem_repo/src/fairchem/core/units/mlip_unit/mlip_unit.py:408)

settings.name: cosine_lr_scheduler_fn.lr_min_factor
settings.meaning: Final LR as a fraction of lr at the end of the cosine decay.
settings.default_note: no default: lr_min_factor: float required in _get_consine_lr_scheduler (fairchem_repo/src/fairchem/core/units/mlip_unit/mlip_unit.py:409)

settings.name: clip_grad_norm
settings.meaning: Max gradient norm; None disables clipping.

settings.name: ema_decay
settings.meaning: EMA decay of an AveragedModel copy; the EMA model is used for evaluation. Not set in the FT template, so the code default applies.

settings.name: bf16
settings.meaning: bfloat16 autocast for forward pass. Not set in the FT template (code default False).

settings.name: print_every
settings.meaning: Log every N steps.

settings.name: save_inference_ckpt
settings.meaning: Also write inference_ckpt.pt next to each training checkpoint (loadable by load_predict_unit).

settings.name: train_strategy
settings.meaning: DDP or FSDP wrapping of the model.

settings.name: max_neighbors
settings.meaning: Backbone neighbor cap override applied when loading the checkpoint (model.overrides.backbone.max_neighbors).

settings.name: data.regress_stress
settings.meaning: Backbone override that makes the conserving EFS head compute stress via the strain derivative. True in all three data YAMLs, even e/ef.

settings.name: evaluate_every_n_steps
settings.meaning: Run validation every N train steps (None = only per epoch).

settings.name: checkpoint_every_n_steps
settings.meaning: TrainCheckpointCallback saves checkpoints/step_N every N steps; a final checkpoint is always written at train end.
settings.default_note: no default: checkpoint_every_n_steps: int required in TrainCheckpointCallback (fairchem_repo/src/fairchem/core/components/train/train_runner.py:75)

settings.name: max_saved_checkpoints
settings.meaning: Keeps only the newest N step checkpoints (older dirs are rmtree'd on rank 0).

settings.name: energy loss coefficient
settings.meaning: Weight of the per-atom MAE energy loss (DDPMTLoss wrapper around PerAtomMAELoss).

settings.name: forces loss coefficient
settings.meaning: Weight of the L2-norm force loss (ef and efs templates only; in the e template forces are inference_only).

settings.name: stress loss coefficient
settings.meaning: Weight of the MAE stress loss (efs template only; in e/ef, stress is inference_only).

settings.name: loss reduction
settings.meaning: DDP-aware reduction (mean|sum|per_structure).

settings.name: train_on_free_atoms
settings.meaning: Exclude FixAtoms-constrained atoms from the force loss.

settings.name: inference_only
settings.meaning: Task is dropped from training/eval (filter_inference_only_tasks) — how e/ef templates disable force/stress losses.

settings.name: data.normalizer_rmsd
settings.meaning: Normalizer rmsd for energy/forces/stress targets; generated = force RMS over up to 100000 sampled train frames (1.0 for regression-tasks e).
settings.default_note: computed, not a literal: force RMS from compute_normalizer_and_linear_reference on the training set, forced to 1.0 when --regression-tasks e (fairchem_repo/src/fairchem/core/scripts/create_uma_finetune_dataset.py:126-131)

settings.name: data.elem_refs
settings.meaning: Per-element (Z 0..99) linear energy references from least squares on train energies, subtracted by ElementReferences.
settings.default_note: computed, not a literal: np.linalg.lstsq fit of energies on per-element counts of the training set (fairchem_repo/src/fairchem/core/scripts/create_finetune_dataset.py:83)

settings.name: seed (sampler)
settings.meaning: BalancedBatchSampler shuffle seed.
settings.default_note: no default: keyword-only seed: int in the balanced batch sampler (fairchem_repo/src/fairchem/core/common/data_parallel.py:133)

settings.name: job.seed
settings.meaning: Global job seed.

settings.name: num_workers (dataloader)
settings.meaning: Torch DataLoader worker processes.
settings.default_note: no default: num_workers is a required positional argument of get_dataloader (fairchem_repo/src/fairchem/core/components/common/dataloader_builder.py:17-18)

settings.name: job.device_type
settings.meaning: CUDA or CPU.

settings.name: job.scheduler.ranks_per_node
settings.meaning: Ranks (GPUs) per node; >1 gives local multi-GPU DDP.

settings.name: job.scheduler.num_nodes
settings.meaning: Node count (multi-node needs mode=SLURM).

settings.name: job.scheduler.mode
settings.meaning: LOCAL or SLURM launcher.

settings.name: job.debug
settings.meaning: Debug mode; W&B logger is only created when debug is False.

settings.name: job.run_dir
settings.meaning: Root for logs/checkpoints/results (<run_dir>/<timestamp_id>/...).
settings.default_note: no literal: default_factory=lambda: tempfile.TemporaryDirectory().name, i.e. a fresh temp dir per job (fairchem_repo/src/fairchem/core/launchers/api.py:130)
